title: In 2013, Amanda Seyfried bought a 1930s farm in Catskills; she converted the barn into a two-bedroom guesthouse and turned the property into a nonprofit animal rescue
summary_full: Amanda Seyfried has rejuvenated a charming 1930s farm in the Catskills, turning it into a cozy family haven and a sanctuary for rescued animals. Not only did she expand the farmhouse, but she also transformed the barn into a delightful guesthouse. As a nonprofit animal rescue, they provide a home to various animals, including horses and dogs.
